canonical_statement: Figure 1 reports that 3,073 records were screened, 2,926 were excluded at screening, and 147 full-text articles were assessed for eligibility.

canonical_statement: Figure 1 reports 16 reports of 15 RCTs included in the qualitative synthesis and 8 RCTs included in the quantitative synthesis (meta-analysis).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 16 reports of 15 RCTs included in qualitative synthesis; 8 RCTs included in quantitative synthesis (meta-analysis)

canonical_statement: In all 15 included studies, people with cancer constituted subgroups rather than the entire trial population.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In all 15 included studies, participants with cancer constituted subgroups.

population.label: People with cancer represented as subgroups within all 15 included RCTs

canonical_statement: Cancer-subgroup data were directly reported in three included studies, reported in follow-up publications for three studies, obtained from study authors for two studies, and taken from two published systematic reviews for seven studies that did not directly report cancer-subgroup data.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: three studies reported data for cancer subgroups ... three studies had follow-up publications reporting cancer subgroup data ... For two studies, we obtained cancer subgroup data from the study authors ... Seven studies did not report cancer subgroup data

canonical_statement: The seven studies whose cancer-subgroup data were taken from prior systematic reviews were excluded from the main analysis and included in sensitivity analyses.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We excluded these seven studies from the main analysis and included them in the sensitivity analyses.

canonical_statement: Of the 15 included studies, 13 compared LMWH with UFH, one compared fondaparinux with heparin (UFH and LMWH), and one compared dalteparin with tinzaparin.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Of the 15 studies, 13 compared LMWH to UFH, one compared fondaparinux to heparin (UFH and LMWH), and one compared dalteparin to tinzaparin

canonical_statement: None of the 15 included studies specified the types of cancer among the participants with cancer.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: None of the studies specified the types of cancer of the participants.

canonical_statement: In 14 of 15 included studies, initial parenteral anticoagulation was followed by oral anticoagulation for at least three months; Duroux 1991 was the exception, with long-term therapy determined by each participating centre as either subcutaneous UFH or oral anticoagulation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In 14 of 15 studies, the initial parenteral anticoagulation was followed by oral anticoagulation for at least three months. In Duroux 1991, the long-term anticoagulation was either subcutaneous (SC) UFH or oral anticoagulation

canonical_statement: From the characteristics tables, 12 of the 15 included studies had follow-up of approximately three months (90 days or 12 weeks), while Koopman 1996, Lindmarker 1994, and Prandoni 1992 reported six-month follow-up.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Duration of follow-up

canonical_statement: Figure 2 shows all 15 included studies judged at low risk for random sequence generation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Risk of bias summary: review authors' judgments about each risk of bias item for each included study

canonical_statement: Allocation concealment was judged adequate in 13 of 15 included studies; Breddin 2001 and Duroux 1991 did not report allocation concealment and were judged high risk in Figure 2.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We judged allocation to be adequately concealed in 13 of the 15 studies ... Two studies did not report on allocation concealment (Breddin 2001; Duroux 1991).

canonical_statement: Participants and personnel were judged definitely blinded in 3 of 15 included studies (Hull 1992, Van Doormaal 2009, and Wells 2005) and definitely not blinded in the other 12 studies.

source_anchor.paragraph: Blinding of participants and personnel (performance bias)
source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: definitely blinded in three of the 15 studies ... and definitely not blinded in 12 studies

canonical_statement: Outcome assessors were judged definitely blinded in 14 included studies and probably not blinded in Duroux 1991; Figure 2 nevertheless records low detection-bias risk for all 15 studies.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We judged outcome assessors to be definitely blinded in 14 studies ... and probably not blinded in one study (Duroux 1991).

canonical_statement: All but three included studies reported complete follow-up; Breddin 2001 reported approximately 91% follow-up in the cancer subgroup, while Duroux 1991 and Merli 2001 did not report cancer-subgroup follow-up information.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All but three studies reported complete follow-up (Breddin 2001; Duroux 1991; Merli 2001). Breddin and colleagues reported an approximate 91% follow-up in the cancer subgroup.

canonical_statement: The review did not suspect selective outcome reporting for any of the 15 included studies, although cancer-subgroup data were missing for seven studies.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We did not suspect selective reporting of outcomes for any of the studies. The cancer subgroup data were missing for seven studies.

canonical_statement: The review authors reported no suspected other potential sources of bias across the included studies.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: None suspected.

canonical_statement: Among excluded full-text articles, 11 studies contained cancer subgroups but lacked available cancer-subgroup outcome data: Albada 1989, Belcaro 1999, Bratt 1990, Büller 2004, Fiessinger 1996, Harenberg 1990, Harenberg 2000, Holm 1986, Hull 2000, Luomanmaki 1996, and Riess 2003.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: in 11 full-text articles, people with cancer constituted study subgroups but their outcome data were not available

canonical_statement: Figure 1 lists the following reasons among 131 excluded full-text articles from 87 RCTs: not the population of interest (86), not the intervention of interest (17), not the design of interest (27), and no relevant cancer-subgroup data (1).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 131 full-text articles of 87 RCTs excluded, with reason: not population of interest (n = 86); not intervention of interest (n = 17); not design of interest (n = 27); no relevant data for cancer subgroup (n=1)
